milestones.label: Sprint Triathlon
milestones.note: Your first triathlon finish line! Race at an easy-hard effort and enjoy it — everything since week 1 has led here.

milestones.label: Olympic Triathlon
milestones.note: Double the sprint distance. Pace the bike conservatively so the 10K run doesn't fall apart.

milestones.label: Half-Iron Triathlon (70.3)
milestones.note: A huge benchmark — if you finish this feeling strong, the full distance is a question of patience, not fitness.

milestones.label: Full Ironman (140.6)
milestones.note: Race day. Sixteen months of work for this one. Trust your pacing, fuel early and often, and smile at mile 20 — you earned it.
